sourceRulesScreened.rule: Attack: make attacks legally granted by class and weapon; replacing one attack does not replace the entire Action unless specified.
sourceRulesScreened.finding: This action rule does not by itself authorize an attack against a structure or establish a weapon.

sourceRulesScreened.rule: Sunder attacks an object, shield, armor component, or construct joint using its actual durability system; unspecified durability remains an equipment dependency.
sourceRulesScreened.finding: Sunder line 136 supplies an object/component target route and delegates to actual durability only for an otherwise lawful attack. It supplies no weapon, attack grant, acquisition, custody, damage profile, or override for creature-only spell targeting.

sourceRulesScreened.rule: An improvised weapon includes any object the user can wield in one or two hands; an object with no resemblance to a weapon deals 1d4 damage of a Director-assigned appropriate type.
sourceRulesScreened.finding: Rulebook v6 permits a wieldable object as an improvised weapon; objects with no resemblance to a weapon use 1d4 with an appropriate Director-assigned damage type. Combined with Sunder, this supplies a targetable damaging method when the object and attack are otherwise lawful. It does not grant proficiency.

preflightFinding.summary: The Director confirms the conditional profile’s acquired, always-prepared Minor Conjuration plus a wieldable improvised object and Sunder can satisfy W01’s lawful damaging-source requirement for a TEST_ONLY review. Campaign occurrence and an ordinary prepared-slot entry are not required. W01 remains open because no concrete object, paid attack event, structural witness, or panel/support/navigation resolution has been constructed.
remainingPredicates: Preserve the historical parent; identify the conditional actor and bind current resources, conditions, hands/focus and casting histories.

Specify one permitted object’s identity, material, dimensions, weight and wieldability. Record lawful creation in an unoccupied space within 10 feet, components, Action, applicable RP/strain and interrupt decisions.
Record pickup/custody, hand availability and the subsequent paid attack opportunity. Preserve the object’s expiry and replacement-dismissal rules.

Bind reach, geometry, ordinary weapon-attack modifiers, proficiency treatment, damage type and actual attack/damage inputs. Do not substitute the Wizard spell-attack bonus or grant proficiency without a source.
Resolve damage against the named Q23 target, with the required panel/support/navigation graph and dependent consequences; supply deterministic forward/inverse evidence.
